notes: Search summaries blend pages; URLs for the hospital-leaflet claims (Royal Berkshire) and the anaemia-by-stage sentence (Kidney Care UK) were not named with certainty in the returned text, so a human should confirm them. First-pass attributions of '2 in 100' to the NHS main page was reported in one search; another search could not confirm it and 111 Wales / Kidney Care UK give 1 in 50 (same figure). Several first-pass claims (lithium/omeprazole monitoring, dietitian referral, iron for most, mechanism of bone disease) could not be retrieved and were removed. Only a few edited sentences (e.g. erythropoiesis-stimulating agents) rely on review papers, not UK publishers.
